2022_230_nov_2021_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly procurement-card (PCARD) transaction listing for November 2021, presented on the Board of Education agenda of January 18, 2022 and printed 1/13/2022 across 35 pages. Every line is posted under the journal entry "NOV PCARD EXP" and carries a posting date, an abbreviated merchant name, a budget unit string, an A/C code, and an amount, with transaction dates running from 10/26/2021 through 11/26/2021. The report closes with a subtotal of 287,228.70 and credits of 3,998.81, yielding Total Expenses of 283,229.89. The single largest charge is 8,600.00 to KEITH S MICH against budget unit 700970699990000.

**Report identity**
Troy School District PCARD (procurement card) report covering November 2021, appearing on the Board of Education agenda dated January 18, 2022. Each of the 35 numbered pages repeats the banner "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, November 2021" and is footed with the print date 1/13/2022.

**Format**
Columns are Transaction Description, JE Number, Budget Unit, A/C Code, Transaction Amount, and Credits. Every row bears the same JE Number, "NOV PCARD EXP." The description field concatenates a posting date with a truncated merchant descriptor (for example "11/24/2021-GALCO INDUST" or "11/8/2021-AMZN MKTP US"). Posting dates range from 10/26/2021 to 11/26/2021. Amounts appear either in the Transaction Amount column or, for refunds and rebates, in the Credits column.

2022_230_nov_2021_pcard_report.verbose:
**Document identity and provenance**

Troy School District's procurement-card (PCARD) expenditure report for November 2021, carried on the Board of Education agenda of January 18, 2022. The printout runs 35 numbered pages; the banner "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, November 2021" and the column header row "Transaction Description  JE Number  Budget Unit  A/C Code  Transaction Amount  Credits" repeat at the top of each page, and each page footer pairs the page number with the print date 1/13/2022.

**Structure of the listing**

Every row is a single card transaction. The Transaction Description field concatenates a posting date with a truncated merchant descriptor as captured by the card processor, producing entries such as "11/24/2021-GALCO INDUST," "11/8/2021-AMZN MKTP US," "11/5/2021-STAPLS734300" and "11/3/2021-4677.9038.73." All rows share the same JE Number, "NOV PCARD EXP." The Budget Unit column holds a fifteen-digit account string; the A/C Code column holds a four-digit object code. Posting dates run from 10/26/2021 through 11/26/2021, meaning the November statement captures a late-October through late-November cycle. Amounts land either in the Transaction Amount column or, for returns, rebates and reversals, in the Credits column, with the unused column showing a dash.

Budget-unit strings begin with a variety of prefixes: 101 dominates the listing, with substantial blocks also under 700 and 701, plus 120, 122, 419, 529, 530, 531 and 535. A/C codes observed include 3110, 3120, 3190, 3210, 3220, 3311, 3410, 3430, 3450, 3510, 4110, 4120, 5000, 5110, 5310, 5610, 5710, 5910, 5990, 6410, 6420, 7410 and 7910. Charges under 700-prefixed units almost uniformly carry A/C code 5000; 101-prefixed instructional units most often carry 5110 or 5990.

**Totals**

The closing lines report a Subtotal of 287,228.70 against Credits of 3,998.81, and a Total Expenses figure of 283,229.89.

**Largest single charges**

The biggest line in the report is 8,600.00 to KEITH S MICH on 11/17/2021 under budget unit 700970699990000, code 5000. Next is 7,568.40 to AMAZON.COM*S on 11/24/2021 under 101902261387100, code 5990 — the same unit that also absorbed 1,043.36 to SOUTHEASTERN on 11/4/2021, 169.50 to MARSHALL MUS on 11/2/2021 and 67.96 to AMZN MKTP US on 11/22/2021.
